def clean(df):
    # Standardize species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric, coerce errors to NaN, then drop out-of-range values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, coerce errors to NaN, then drop out-of-range values
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Keep the id column (penguin_id) as required
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    result = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return result
